features.name: acceptor_ag_match_score
features.description: Normalized match score for an A followed by G at attributes 29-30, the common acceptor-side boundary dinucleotide.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear margin a smooth, compact cue for a key central motif while retaining partial-match information.

features.name: donor_gt_match_score
features.description: Normalized match score for a G followed by T at attributes 31-32, the common donor-side boundary dinucleotide.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct continuous signal for a frequent central motif that a linear SVM can weight strongly.

features.name: central_exact_boundary_pair_score
features.description: Average of exact AG at attributes 29-30 and exact GT at attributes 31-32, acting as a simple interaction feature around the central boundary.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds conjunction information that is hard for a purely linear model to recover from separate single-position indicators.

features.name: upstream_polypyrimidine_fraction_20_28
features.description: Fraction of C or T symbols in attributes 20-28, representing the upstream polypyrimidine tract near an acceptor-side boundary.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a smooth C/T-rich tract measure that supports linear separation without many sparse categorical indicators.
features.formula: (np.where((attribute_20 == 'C') | (attribute_20 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_21 == 'C') | (attribute_21 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_22 == 'C') | (attribute_22 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_23 == 'C') | (attribute_23 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_24 == 'C') | (attribute_24 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_25 == 'C') | (attribute_25 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_26 == 'C') | (attribute_26 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_27 == 'C') | (attribute_27 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_28 == 'C') | (attribute_28 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0)) / 9.0

features.name: upstream_branch_a_fraction_18_27

features.name: donor_sixmer_consensus_score_31_36
features.description: Six-position donor consensus score over attributes 31-36 using G, T, A/G, A, G, T.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses a short ordered motif into one graded projection well suited for a linear SVM margin.

features.name: central_profile_mode_match_fraction_28_36
features.description: Fraction of attributes 28-36 matching the most frequent nucleotide at the same position in the training fold: C, A, G, G, T, G, A, G, T.

features.formula: (np.where(attribute_28 == 'C', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_29 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_30 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_31 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_32 == 'T', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_33 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_34 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_35 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_36 == 'T', 1.0, 0.0)) / 9.0

features.name: junction_plausibility_judgment
features.description: A 0.0-1.0 expert score based only on the row sequence, rating whether attributes 29-36 form a biologically plausible splice-boundary pattern with coherent central dinucleotides and nearby context.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact nonlinear semantic cue that can be combined with deterministic motif scores by a linear SVM.

features.name: sequence_quality_judgment
features.description: A 0.0-1.0 expert score based only on the 60 observed symbols, rewarding clean A/C/G/T sequence context and penalizing ambiguous letters, unusual local repeats, or extreme composition.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous quality covariate that can reduce sensitivity to noisy or atypical sequence rows.
